***[[Syria]]n government [[warplane]]s carry out a sixth day of [[airstrike]]s in the rebel-held [[Ghouta]] suburbs east of [[Damascus]], killing 32 people as the death toll from a week of bombardment reaches over 400. ;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[Rick Gates (political consultant)|Rick Gates]] pleads guilty to charges of conspiracy against the United States and making false statements, and agrees to cooperate with the Special Counsel investigation. [https://www.npr.org/2018/02/23/588253673/rick-gates-paul-manaforts-business-partner-expected-to-plead-guilty (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Australia]]
**[[Barnaby Joyce]] announces his resignation as [[Deputy Prime Minister of Australia|Deputy Prime Minister]] and leader of the [[National Party of Australia|National Party]], following scandals involving an [[affair]] with a staffer and a [[sexual harassment]] allegation. The party, a junior partner in the [[Coalition (Australia)|Coalition]] [[Turnbull Government|government]], will [[National Party of Australia leadership election, 2018|vote for his successor]] on February 26. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2018/feb/23/barnaby-joyce-deputy-prime-minister-leadership-national-party-live (''The Guardian'')]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball corruption scandal]]
**Documents obtained through legal discovery filings during the ongoing [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] probe into college basketball corruption reveal potential current and retroactive [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] rules issues for at least 20 [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] programs and more than 25 players. In addition to programs named when federal criminal charges were first revealed in September 2017, among the programs potentially implicated in the new documents are [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]], [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]], and [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]]. [https://sports.yahoo.com/exclusive-federal-documents-detail-sweeping-potential-ncaa-violations-involving-high-profile-players-schools-103338484.html (Yahoo! Sports)]
